## Summary

- archive all fourteen accepted Phase 24 Decision-prerequisite receipts
- preserve each exact realization release edge without starting implementation

## Validation

- candidate changes only the Phase 24 archive, execution plan, and phase ledger
- candidate and integration main share the verified src tree 483c7756667335b502105dfa4a712b128a7a117b
- reused the Phase 25 full gate: 87 files / 679 tests, lint, typecheck, and seven-route build
- git diff --check and the detached candidate audit passed
